name: Construction of NABARD-Funded Minor Irrigation Projects - Uttarakhand
benefit: Under the scheme, farmers will be provided free irrigation facilities. The following works will be undertaken to provide irrigation facilities to the farmers under the scheme: - Solar Pump Irrigation Scheme - Pipeline / Water Channel (Gool) - Water Storage Tank / Geo-lined Tank - Construction of Check Dam (Hilly Areas) - Small Gated Weir (Plains Areas)
_eligibility_text: 1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The beneficiary must be a farmer engaged in agricultural activities. 1. Under the scheme, collective irrigation projects are constructed. 1. Projects that are beneficial and essential, with a cost of ₹4.00 lakh per hectare and a benefit-cost ratio of more than 1.0, are included. 1. Check dams are constructed at suitable locations based on the proposals received and the survey conducted.
